answer: Entry is a one-shot dawn harvest, not a key census. An applicant posts 19.3 POA and a sealed claim before an 11-byte glacier melt sample is published at a random minute. Three established harvesters, none sharing a parent and allowed one harvest this epoch, recompute a 48-step hash of sample plus claim and file it at the same inlet within 80 seconds. Explorers confirm the claim predates the sample, the hashes agree, and caps hold. A 4,800-key farm needs 92,640 POA and 14,400 harvesters in one minute. A late file, hash mismatch, or shared parent burns 70% and grounds them for five epochs.
